title: apply --push keeps only check's first 10 problem lines, so the redact note is cut from the refusal text when check prints more
goal: the refusal text apply --push writes carries check's redact note whatever the number of problem lines, so the operator always sees where the remedy is written
repro_reason: a store with 10 or more failing entries and a refused push is needed to run it; the slice that drops the note is the line the fix changes

run:
import pathlib, sys, tempfile
sys.path.insert(0, "_tools")
import ql_deliver, ql_store
home = pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp()); qdir = pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp())
lines = ["entry-%02d.json:1: the leak scan flags a path" % i for i in range(12)] + [ql_store.REDACT_NOTE]
run = lambda argv, cwd=None: (1, "\n".join(lines) + "\n", "")
said = []
p = ql_deliver.Pusher(home, qdir, run, None, said.append, cloud=False)
code = p.bring([], [])
text = "\n".join(said)
ok = code == 1 and ql_store.REDACT_NOTE in text
print("exit", code, "| note kept after 12 problem lines:", ql_store.REDACT_NOTE in text)
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)

notes: Plan 2026-10-24: premise reproduces (the added check, a Pusher.bring run on 12 problem lines and the redact note, fails on the base). The text-only repro stays as the bug's report.
